calculators.title: Lüders Band Simulator
calculators.desc: Pull a mild steel bar and watch the yield band run along it at 55° while the force stays flat. Notches, machine stiffness, strain ageing.

calculators.title: Prime Numbers
calculators.desc: Is it prime? Prime factors, divisors, coprime, GCD and LCM, the sieve and the prime spiral.

calculators.title: Quantum Calculators
calculators.desc: de Broglie wavelength, photon energy, the uncertainty principle, tunnelling probability, particle in a box, the Bohr model, Compton shift and blackbody radiation, with every formula shown.

calculators.title: Relative Speed & Strength Calculator
calculators.desc: Animal speeds (running, flying, swimming), strength, jumps and falls scaled to human size.

calculators.title: Relative Time Calculator
calculators.desc: How long an hour feels at another age: share of life, felt life and animal lifespans.

calculators.title: Practice Tests (FSA Style)
calculators.desc: Grade 4 and 7 numeracy and reading practice with new questions every time and every answer explained.

calculators.title: Bending Stress & Beam Calculator
calculators.desc: Drag loads along a beam: shear and moment diagrams, deflection and σ = Mc/I for I-beams, tubes and more.

calculators.title: BMI Calculator for Kids and Teens
calculators.desc: BMI-for-age percentile for ages 2 to 19 on the CDC growth chart.

calculators.title: Compound Interest Calculator
calculators.desc: Grow savings with monthly deposits: year-by-year table and chart, goals, APY and the rule of 72.

calculators.title: Loan Calculator
calculators.desc: Monthly payment, total interest, payoff date and schedule for car, personal and student loans, with extra payments and APR.

calculators.title: Age Calculator
calculators.desc: Exact age in years, months and days, days lived, next birthday, milestones and the age gap between two people.

calculators.title: Fuel Cost Calculator
calculators.desc: What a trip costs in fuel, from distance, L/100 km or mpg and price, split per person, plus EV comparison.

tools.title: Quantum Cryptography
tools.desc: Send a key with photons (BB84), watch Shor's algorithm factor and Grover's search find, see what is quantum-safe, and run real post-quantum ML-KEM (Kyber).

tools.title: Quantum-Safe Website Checker
tools.desc: Paste links and see if each site's HTTPS uses post-quantum encryption (X25519MLKEM768), with its TLS version and certificate, graded A to F.

tools.title: Cryptography Lab
tools.desc: Encrypt, decrypt and crack Caesar and Vigenère ciphers, build RSA keys from primes step by step, Diffie-Hellman, hashes and real AES password encryption.

tools.title: Text Viewer (TXT, RTF, Code)
tools.desc: Open .txt, .md, .rtf, .csv, .json, .html and code files: a formatted reading view or a code view with line numbers, read aloud, edit and save. Nothing is uploaded.

tools.title: Narration
tools.desc: Type a script, get a voice-over: 28 natural voices or your own voice from a 15-second sample. MP3, M4A or WAV, or straight into the Video Editor.

tools.title: Car Sandbox
tools.desc: Drive cars, trucks and a lunar rover in 3D on a test track, the Moon, Mars or Ceres: jumps, a loop, crashes, computer cars, loose objects and any gravity you like.

tools.title: Chess
tools.desc: Play the computer, a friend, online or on Hive, in 2D or 3D venues, with Chess960, clocks and analysis.

tools.title: Bridge Builder
tools.desc: Design a truss, arch or cable bridge, check every member, auto-size it for the lowest cost, then drive trucks over it, blow wind and shake it with an earthquake.

tools.title: Draw (Drawing Pad)
tools.desc: Sketch with pens, markers and spray, add shapes, arrows, text, emoji and symbols, start from templates or colouring pages, then download PNG or SVG.

tools.title: Brick Builder (3D building bricks)
tools.desc: Build with virtual bricks in 3D, start from example builds for kids and bridges, test how much weight your build holds and follow the steps with real bricks.

tools.title: Quantum Lab
tools.desc: Watch a wave packet tunnel through a barrier, build double-slit stripes one particle at a time, run a Bell test on entangled pairs, send atoms through Stern-Gerlach magnets and explore hydrogen orbitals.

tools.title: Billiards: 8-Ball, 9-Ball & Snooker
tools.desc: Pool and snooker with real spin physics, against the computer, a friend or a Hive player, plus trick-shot challenges.
